text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of Narita Taishin's debut is here at last!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems rather restless while she waits for the race to begin…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I'm able to ease her nerves with some passionate words of encouragement.
